crossRefs.note: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
“Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;
when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,
I was angry because of the iniquity of his covetousness and struck him. I hid myself and was angry; and he went on…
I have seen his ways, and will heal him. I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.
They will come with weeping. I will lead them with petitions. I will cause them to walk by rivers of waters, in a…
But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
My soul shall be joyful in Yahweh. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains, for Yahweh has comforted his people, and will…
I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of…
My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will…
Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help…
Yahweh, I know that the way of man is not in himself. It is not in man who walks to direct his steps.
Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has…
who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in…
For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry…
Now the Lord is the Spirit and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”
So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

translations.web: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
translations.bsb: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and sustain me with a willing spirit.
translations.kjv: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
translations.asv: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; And uphold me with a willing spirit.
